automatedChecks: Run all 12 contract tests and the two-input free smoke from a clean download.
Validate cast/universe rules, authorized local media paths, measured durations and caption coverage before rendering.
Verify 1080 × 1920 (9:16), square pixels, 25 fps H.264/AAC output, visible caption pixels and supplied audio in the diagnostic proofs.
Keep the official runtime unchanged when replacing content.
creativeReview: Watch and listen to the entire real episode; check character performance, intelligibility, pacing and caption/speech synchronization.
Record direct review separately from technical checks. Publication approval is not an invented quality score.
Do not use synthetic video or tones as the finished real episode.
limits: This baseline requires supplied gameplay and per-turn audio; no automatic acquisition, voice generation or transcription.
Output is 9:16 vertical at 1080 × 1920; ASCII captions and up to 60 seconds. Gameplay is center-cropped, never stretched.
No music mixing, visual character animation or automatic speech alignment.
